<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="products-crypto-investing">
InvestingˆandˆcryptocurrencyˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvesting,ˆbrokerageˆorˆretirementˆaccounts,ˆandˆyouˆcan'tˆbuy,ˆsellˆorˆholdˆcryptocurrencyˆwithˆus.ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆtoˆanˆinvestmentˆappˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆtoˆanˆinvestmentˆorˆcryptoˆplatformˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆbyˆACH,ˆlikeˆanyˆotherˆexternalˆaccount.ˆSomeˆplatformsˆalsoˆacceptˆdebitˆcardˆpayments.ˆ##ˆCryptoˆpurchasesˆwithˆyourˆcardˆSomeˆcryptoˆplatformsˆtreatˆcardˆpurchasesˆasˆcashˆadvances.ˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆcashˆadvanceˆfees,ˆbutˆtheˆplatformˆmight.ˆCardˆpurchasesˆfromˆcryptoˆplatformsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputedˆifˆyouˆsimplyˆchangeˆyourˆmind.ˆ##ˆScamsˆBeˆcarefulˆofˆanyoneˆpromisingˆguaranteedˆreturnsˆorˆaskingˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoneyˆintoˆcryptoˆtoˆkeepˆitˆsafe.ˆThat'sˆaˆcommonˆscam.ˆ##ˆAdviceˆSupportˆcan'tˆadviseˆyouˆonˆinvestmentsˆorˆcryptocurrency.ˆ##ˆEarningˆmoreˆonˆsavingsˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆinterestˆatˆyourˆplan'sˆrate.ˆSeeˆtheˆsavingsˆrateˆarticleˆforˆyourˆplan.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
